# OPSOAI — {{ site.url }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}

OPSOAI publishes one source-checked global AI story every morning and afternoon.
Every new story is published as a linked English and Korean pair with reciprocal language URLs.
Each story explains what happened, what changed, how it works, who is affected, what to watch next, and what remains unverified.
Key takeaways, FAQs, named entities, direct citations, and credited source images help answer engines preserve context.

Core topics: generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, product launches, company strategy, policy and regulation, research, and real-world adoption.
